| Planning pathway | Development application (DA) |

| Site conditions | Work to an existing building; Site stays occupied or operating during the works; Delivered in stages; Several buildings or a campus; Parts with different NCC classes; BCA advisory requested; Certification requested; Existing BCA extent agreed; Classification map required; Occupied/staged BCA assessment; Fire referrals/witnessing required; Residential evidence review required |

### 2. Your role

A: design-team BCA adviser; identify risks and evidence gaps, coordinate specialists and report. No statutory appointment or specialist design.
B: independent regulatory assessor for expressly appointed functions. Fees buy assessment and duties; issue of a certificate depends on satisfactory assessment.
Disclose involvement/conflicts; separate appointments where needed. No ordinary D&C novation of B; advisory transfer needs independence review. Inspections do not replace supervision or specialist work.

### 3. Scope by stage

Confirm separate A/B boundaries in R1. Base stages only; later stages are options requiring written/statutory appointment. Advice-only uses A; CDC/other routes need separately confirmed scope. Options are priced on their own and are not in the base fee.

| Stage | Deliverable at sign-off |
|---|---|
| A1 Inception / schematic advice | Review brief/plans; classifications/code basis, markups, high-level report, action register and specialist input schedule. Inspect accessible affected existing fabric; state investigation limits. |
| A2 Planning submission advice | Review planning drawings/interfaces and proposed performance solutions; draft/final BCA statement and applicable draft fire safety schedule. Ends at submission; price later responses separately. |
| A3 Detailed design / tender advice | Review updated plans, selected upgrade interfaces and specialist briefs/reports; tender BCA report records unresolved specialist design and statutory assessment issues. |
| B1 Preliminary regulatory assessment | Preliminary-document assessment, regulatory report and evidence checklist; scheduled visit. Identify independence limits on design advice. |
| B2 Construction approval assessment | CC checklist/condition register; assess plans, specialist evidence and scheduled solutions/referrals; determine each CC package with reasons/outstanding actions, supporting documents and applicable fire safety schedule. |
| B3 Principal-certifier construction services | Appointment notices/inspection schedule, booking responsibilities and notice; scheduled inspections/photo reports, close-out and missed-inspection records; witness/referral tasks, occupation checklist and required compliance/complaint duties. |
| B4 Occupation assessment / handover | Assess conditions and completion evidence; final inspection/fire-authority coordination; determine each OC package. Certificates or reasons/outstanding items, approved-document index, inspection records and fire safety schedule; separate from practical completion. |
| A4 Construction advisory support (option) | BCA query/changed-design advice and action updates within allowances; price advisory visits, detail reviews and completion report individually. No statutory appointment. The client opts in. |

### 4. Allowances

Price these quantities; identify insufficiency before engagement. Allowances never permit omission of required statutory duties. R1/R6 must state authorised assumed counts, unit rates and fee effects.

| Item | Allowance | Item | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Plan assessments | 2 plan sets per stage; R1 states revision baseline and coordinated review rounds | Reports / checklists | 2 per deliverable; R2 separates draft, final and updates by purpose |
| Meetings | 2 by stage; R1 states duration/location | RFI support | 2 design-team hours; state regulatory-feedback basis separately |
| Performance solutions | 2 brief/report versions per named author/solution; distinguish comment and assessment | CC applications | 2 named packages/areas; amendments separate |
| OC applications | 2 named occupation packages/areas | Visits | 2 total; R1 splits audit/pre-CC/critical/progress/reinspection/final/fire attendance and identifies overlap |
| Tests / referrals | 2 events; split hours, initial/final submissions, responses/resubmissions and out-of-hours | Duration / access | 2 months; state dates, safe access, travel area, occupied restrictions and cancellation notice |

### 5. Scope position

Service levels are set for a simple project; technical items follow the project's own facts.
Included in the fee: Compliance evidence, action and condition registers (PDF/editable), every selected stage; Statutory/principal-certifier functions: Package B only, separate from A; Existing/fit-out/extension/changed-use assessment: agreed extent; opening-up/surveys by named others; no whole-building upgrade assumed; Mixed-use/building/tenancy classification and approval map: shared egress, fire/services and shell/tenant boundaries; Occupied/staged occupation boundaries and certificate packages; designers design temporary measures, contractor sets methods; Fire-system/authority referrals and witnessing; contractor/specialists test and certify; Residential energy/design-evidence review (e.g. BASIX), only if required.
Optional: price each on its own line in R1: Performance-solution assessment; specialist author and assessor are different parties; Extra visits, missed inspections and changed approved design: contingency rates/notice; required statutory action is not optional.
Excluded: the party named does it: Detailed access/energy/structural/acoustic/waterproofing/passive-fire/bushfire design (separately appointed specialist (name in R4)); Utility/adjoining-owner/planning/road/demolition approvals (client / project lead (name in R4)); Building supervision, contractual quality, methods and recurring annual inspections; no automatic retainer (builder / contract administrator / owner (name in R4)).
Tell us in R6 if you disagree with any line. Do not add your own general exclusions; any you add are treated as non-compliant.

### 6. Terms

- Agree Project BCA appointment agreement (attached), precedence and departures before appointment. Confirm current NSW appointing-party, contract, declarations, independence, payment and replacement requirements.
- Agree extra scope/allowance/fee/time changes in writing before work; notify reason, baseline and cost. Required statutory action proceeds with prompt notice/cost records under the contingency basis.
- Design sign-off sets the pricing baseline; normal agreed design development remains included. Regulatory assessment/determination is independent of client sign-off.
- Correcting your own errors, or coordinating with information you were given, is not a variation.
- A: monthly itemised invoices, 30 days; no automatic final-report withholding. B: separate verified statutory payment milestones before issue/appointment. Agree advance-fee refunds/reconciliation.
- Your proposal stays valid for 90 days.
- Questions in writing to Project manager, pm@example.com by 2026-10-23; answers go to every tenderer as numbered addenda.
- Disclose fee dependencies, escalation and liability/time-bar/indemnity/insurance/transfer departures. Maintain eligibility; notify conflicts/substitutions. Agree notice/cure, fee reconciliation, records/replacement and disputes under the agreement; required duties continue.
- Client supplies inputs/safe access; report gaps and reliance limits without blanket waiver. Agree project-team/authority/operator use licence, editable registers/native outputs, confidentiality with statutory disclosure, retention and handover.

### 7. Evaluation

Technical coverage and method 35% · Named team and independence 25% · Achievable program 15% · Evaluated fee 25%. First assess role eligibility, independence, scope completeness, insurance and material departures. Compare common allowances/options and contingency exposure; approval guarantees are not an advantage. Lowest price need not win.
